residueMeasurement.countingRuleUsed: CTX-STAGE2's rule verbatim (quoted from _inbox/2026-09-09_ctx-stage2_close.json step4_residue.countingRule): denom_incity = COUNT(DISTINCT prop_id) from landing_parcel_jurisdiction WHERE city_name='Elgin' AND place_fips='23044' AND disposition='in-city' AND county_fips=C AND prop_id NOT IN ('','0'). denom_with_geom = EXISTS aggregation per parcel against txgio_parcel geom IS NOT NULL (never a flat join, since txgio_parcel carries multiple rows per prop_id). matched_count = EXISTS aggregation of ST_Contains(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(z.geometry::text),4326), ST_PointOnSurface(p.geom)) against tx_zoning_district_staging rows with layer_role='base', is_overlay=false, city_key IN ('elgin-tx','elgin-tx-travis'). residue_unmatched = denom_with_geom - matched_count. Ran with city_key restriction, a bbox pre-filter (p.east_lng>=z.west_lng AND p.west_lng<=z.east_lng AND p.north_lat>=z.south_lat AND p.south_lat<=z.north_lat) on both tables' numeric bbox columns, and statement_timeout=45000, per AGENT_CONTRACT's own named trap (CTX-STAGE2 lost over an hour to the unrestricted version).
residueMeasurement.unexpectedResult_reportedAsInstructed: The dispatch's own text expected Bastrop's raw residue to drop from 36 toward 26. What was measured instead: 48, IDENTICAL to CTX-STAGE2's own recorded pre-fix number (48) for this exact county under this exact method. Per the dispatch's explicit instruction ('Report what you measure, not what is expected'), reporting this plainly rather than reconciling it away.
residueMeasurement.decompositionProvingTheFixWorkedAnyway: Computed a same-table-state counterfactual (matched_count with tx_zoning_district_staging's S-P rows excluded from the join, everything else identical -- NOT a re-query of old data, since REPLACE semantics overwrote the pre-fix rows; this is a same-moment simulation): matched_excl_sp = 3691 vs matched_incl_sp (the real post-fix number) = 3701, a difference of exactly 10 -- matching the 10 named parcels one-for-one. So under a same-table-state comparison, THIS FIX's own marginal contribution is unambiguous: +10 matched / -10 residue (58 -> 48 by that internal decomposition), directly corroborated by the per-parcel verification above. The unresolved part is why the AGGREGATE lands on 48 rather than something lower than CTX-STAGE2's own recorded 48 -- since CTX-STAGE2 measured 48 HOURS before S-P was ever staged (S-P was skipped, not present, at that time: 3209 staged / 11 skipped), its matched_count=3701 should mathematically have been achievable only via non-S-P matches, i.e. it should equal this lane's matched_excl_sp=3691, not 3701. It does not. This is a genuine, unexplained agreement between two counts that should differ by 10 and don't (DEV_PROCESS rule 1.4), inherited on top of the already-flagged CTX-STAGE2-vs-CTX-ELGIN/ZONESCOPE disagreement (48 vs 36/9) from before this lane started. Not reconciled here -- out of this dispatch's scope, which is the S-P mapping/re-stage itself, not the landing_parcel_jurisdiction raw-residue methodology. Named explicitly in the close as an open thread.
